rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the musical instrument.

example.english: I used to play the drum all the time when I was little.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 seng4 jat6 daa2 gu2

rows.note: Use this for a barrel or large cylindrical container holding liquids.

example.english: This drum is full of cooking oil.
example.jyutping: ni1 tung2 sik6 jau4 mun5 saai3

rows.note: Use this for a rotating cylindrical machine part, such as a washing-machine drum.

example.jyutping: sai2 ji1 gei1 go3 gwan2 tung2 m4 juk1 wo3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the photosensitive drum unit inside a printer.

example.english: The printer's drum needs to be replaced.
example.traditional: 打印機內嘅感光鼓需要更換。
example.jyutping: daa2 jan3 gei1 noi6 ge3 gam2 gwong1 gu2 seoi1 jiu3 gang1 wun6
